count_definitions.box_rows: One object annotation in one frame; repeated tracks across frames are not independent objects.
count_definitions.visible: SDD lost=0, including occluded and interpolated source rows; not visually verified.
count_definitions.track_ids: Distinct IDs within one source sequence and source class, not identities across sequences.
count_definitions.annotated_frames: Distinct frame IDs with annotation rows; video length and pixel alignment not verified.
count_definitions.crc_check: Internal ZIP integrity, not proof of agreement with original publisher files.

sdd.selection_rule: smallest annotation file in each named scene, chosen only to bound inspection bytes; not an evaluation sample

uavdt.daylight_filter: daylight=1 and night=0 and fog=0; not a verified rain-free or independent-location filter
